info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Fosters-v4-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Fosters Listing API provides a comprehensive list of pets available for foster care. This endpoint allows users to retrieve information about various adoptable pets that are currently in need of fostering. It serves as a valuable resource for shelters, foster organizations, and prospective pet foster parents, facilitating the matching process between pets and caregivers. Users can conveniently access detailed information on each pet's characteristics and requirements, empowering them to make informed foster decisions.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of pets available for fostering.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all currently available pets that are seeking foster homes. It helps in finding suitable pets for potential foster families and managing the fostering process effectively.
